Overview

A shadowy network of protectors. Little is known about this group — they seem to identify and recruit those who demonstrate a commitment to protecting common folk.

Reputation

Most people have never heard of the Foundation. Those who have encountered them describe plain rock pendants and cryptic greetings.

Known Members

  • Elder Rowan — Appears to be a local coordinator

Services

Unknown. Members seem to receive a network of contacts and support for humanitarian causes.
